data.name: Francisco
data.long_meaning: The name Francisco comes from the Latin word francus, which means 'free man'. It was used in the Middle Ages to identify people from France, which was considered the land of the free. In Christian tradition, it is also associated with St. Francis of Assisi, one of the most beloved saints in the Catholic Church.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes freedom and the ability to live according to one's own beliefs and values.

data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Francisco holds special spiritual significance due to its association with St. Francis of Assisi. Born in Italy in 1112, St. Francis is known for his deep devotion to God and his radical attachment to poverty and nature. His legacy includes founding the Franciscan Order, which is dedicated to living in poverty, and his work helping the sick, the poor, and the marginalized. The name Francisco is a reminder of the Christian call to follow in the footsteps of St. Francis, to embrace the simplicity and humility of the Gospel, and to uplift the most vulnerable among us.

He was appointed the fourth General of the Society of Jesus in 1565.

Francisco de Miranda, a Venezuelan military leader, politician, and revolutionary, was born on February 25, 1750, in Cumaná, Venezuela.
